name: Rakuen no Rukia
source:
After the passing of his grandmother who was his only relative, Kazuma returns to a boarding school Meikyou Seigakuen in his hometown. Located in the mountains, it is a quiet school. There he meets his childhood friend Mikoto who he thought had perished in the great fire ten years ago. Likewise, she thought that he had died, so they were happy to be back together once again. However, on the night of every full moon there is a ‘bloodsucking incident’. He noticed that Mikoto acting suspiciously and soon he is wrapped up in events that he does not understand.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/09/01/september-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
唯一的亲人祖母去世后，Kazuma回到故乡的寄宿学校“明镜圣学园”。学校位于群山之中，十分宁静。在那里，他遇见了青梅竹马Mikoto；Kazuma原以为她已在十年前的大火中丧生，而Mikoto也一直以为他已经死去，两人都为能够重逢而欣喜。然而，每逢满月之夜，学校都会发生“吸血事件”。他注意到Mikoto举止可疑，很快便被卷入一连串无法理解的事件。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/09/01/september-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
